classification: coverage-only; not proof of a write by the candidate release or legal permit approval
normalization: ASCII numeric GTINs 8..14 digits left padded to14; no checksum-only registration inference
sharedSizeDefinition: distinct (techSize, wbSize) labels; distinct WB variants separately reported using (nmID, chrtID)
limitations: Exact code membership proves coverage in this Catalog account only; it does not establish item/color/size identity, ownership, legal permit scope, or a new marketplace write.
A different Catalog account could contain other WB barcodes; this report does not infer a wrong owner or an unregistered product globally.

sanitization.scope: Aggregate counts, HTTP statuses, field rules and inference limits only.
